summary: Wrote URL-shortener FMEA: dependency inventory (Postgres has no timeout; Redis unused on path), 12 failure modes, and two real simulations — DB already down (/live 200, connect hang) and connect_timeout=1 (ConnectionTimeout in 4.451s).
evidence: Inventory: api/app/db.py create_engine(DATABASE_URL) has no connect_timeout; REDIS_URL is config-only; no external HTTP APIs in main.py; logs are stdout StreamHandler.

Simulation 1 (DB down, no docker stop because daemon/port already unused): ASGI GET /live -> 200 {"ok":true}; default engine.connect hung in Module 04 and GET /ready blocked BREAK (killed). No 5xx metric for the hang.
Simulation 2: connect_args connect_timeout=1 -> SIM2_RESULT OperationalError, SIM2_ELAPSED_S 4.451, message connection timeout expired. Production engine still has no timeout (gap).
Risk surface counted: 6 hang/crash/unhandled modes on the request path (Postgres down/slow, pool, DNS, disk, OOM).
